name: status-probe
description: Status bar items driven by your own commands: each prints JSON lines (text, tooltip, ok/warn/error, a link), re-run on an interval or started once to report changes as they happen.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Status Probe runs commands from your settings, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.

statusProbe.items.markdownDescription: Status bar items. Each item re-runs `command` every `intervalSeconds`, or with `watch` starts it once and updates whenever it prints a line. A line may be JSON `{ "text", "tooltip", "level", "open" }`; anything else shows as plain text.

command.markdownDescription: Shell command to run. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `${userHome}`.

watch.markdownDescription: Start the command once and wait for it to print, instead of re-running it every `intervalSeconds`. Each line it prints, whenever it prints one, becomes the item's status. If it exits, it is started again with backoff.

timeoutSeconds.description: Stop the command and show an error after this many seconds (ignored with watch).

priority.description: Higher sits farther toward the outer edge of its side.
